content:
I just opened a postdoc position at the University of Cambridge to work on Lean and Compilation. Our objective is to fuse the ideas of CakeML, CompCERT, VeLLVM with the ease of use and deep integration that made automatic tools such as Alive widely adopted in the LLVM community. And we do not stop at LLVM but in-fact want to provide powerful verification and automation to the entire MLIR ecosystem. If you are interested, to work with me, @Siddharth Bhat, @Alex Keizer, and @Luisa Cicolini, collaborate closely with the Lean-FRO and our strong PL/Theory colleagues here in Cambridge, and are generally excited about Lean and Compilers, check out our job advert.

The opening is here: https://www.jobs.cam.ac.uk/job/47792/, some of our research is here on https://grosser.science. An early paper about our efforts is will be published at ITP'25 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.03685).

The job opening is for administrative reasons only open until next Sunday, but we may have further openings in the near future. Hence, if you are potentially interested don't hesitate to drop me an email at tobias.grosser@cst.cam.ac.uk. I am happy to have a quick chat even if you are unsure about applying.
